description:
About the job

brand support specialist

Full-time • Remote • Reports to Director, Solutions & Success




About us

brand.ai sits at the intersection of artificial intelligence and brand identity. We're building technology that fundamentally reimagines how brands evolve and express themselves in the world. Our platform enables brands to develop coherent identities that adapt and respond to the rapidly shifting technologically driven cultural landscape while maintaining authenticity.

We believe in educating our customers about the transformative reality of AI expansion and how it's reshaping brand work. We're not just another martech tool. We're building a layer 1 platform that becomes the foundational infrastructure for how brands manage and extend their DNA in an AI-driven world.




About you

The Customer Support Specialist is the front line of the brand.ai customer experience: the brand-literate human who helps sophisticated teams actually use the platform and get value from it day to day. This is the role that keeps customers onboarded, confident, and unblocked.

You deliver our support SLA on the usage side: onboarding, workflow guidance, how-to and configuration questions, and the everyday issues that come up as brand teams put AI to work. Anything that needs code is handed to our Software Engineer, and you own the customer through it.




What you'll do

Onboard new customers and help them build the habits that lead to real adoption
Guide customers through the product and their day-to-day workflows
Own the support queue: triage and resolve usage, how-to, and configuration questions
Meet our support SLA and keep customers informed throughout
Route code-level issues to engineering, own the hand-off, and see them to closure
Turn recurring questions into help content and run light training




What we're looking for

2-4 years in customer support, customer success, or onboarding at B2B SaaS
Able to learn a complex platform quickly and explain it simply
Comfortable troubleshooting usage and clear-eyed about when to escalate to engineering
Enough feel for brand and design to understand what customers are trying to achieve
Excellent communication, patience, and genuine care for the customer




Apply at careers@brand.ai with your resume and a brief note on your approach to customer support.

description:
About the job

¡Ayúdanos a impulsar el futuro de la tecnología en salud!

En Top Doctors Group trabajamos para mejorar la forma en la que las personas acceden a la atención médica. A través de la tecnología, conectamos pacientes, profesionales sanitarios y clínicas para ofrecer una experiencia más accesible, eficiente y humana.

Hoy estamos presentes en 10 países y desarrollamos soluciones digitales que ayudan a miles de profesionales sanitarios a potenciar su actividad y a millones de personas a encontrar la atención sanitaria que necesitan.

Creemos que la tecnología genera un mayor impacto cuando se pone al servicio de las personas. Por eso seguimos creciendo y buscando talento que quiera ayudarnos a construir el futuro de la salud digital en un entorno internacional, innovador y en constante evolución.

💡 ¿Por qué este rol es interesante?

Porque tendrás un impacto directo en el crecimiento de Top Doctors en Latinoamérica. Como Performance Marketing Specialist, liderarás la estrategia de captación digital de pacientes, médicos y centros médicos, siendo responsable de generar oportunidades de negocio a través de campañas de paid media orientadas a resultados.

Tendrás ownership sobre todo el ciclo de las campañas: desde la definición de la estrategia y la gestión de presupuestos hasta la optimización continua y el análisis de resultados. Trabajarás de forma muy cercana con los equipos de Ventas, Marketing y Revenue para asegurar que los leads generados se conviertan en crecimiento real para el negocio.

Tu trabajo tendrá una influencia directa en métricas clave como la generación de leads, el coste de adquisición, la calidad del pipeline comercial y el retorno de la inversión publicitaria, contribuyendo al crecimiento de una de las compañías HealthTech líderes en Latinoamérica.

🚀 Lo que harás en tu día a día


Planear, implementar y optimizar campañas de paid media en Google Ads (Search, Display, YouTube, Performance Max), Meta Ads (Facebook e Instagram) y redes de afiliados.
Liderar la captación digital de los tres segmentos clave: pacientes, médicos/especialistas y centros médicos o clínicas.
Gestionar y distribuir el presupuesto de inversión publicitaria (media budget) para maximizar el ROI, minimizar el CPA/CAC y escalar la adquisición de forma sostenible.
Dar seguimiento continuo a los leads generados y colaborar con el equipo de Ventas para cerrar el loop de conversión, identificando fricciones y oportunidades de mejora.
Definir, monitorear y reportar los KPIs de performance: CPL, CPC, CPA, ROAS, CAC, tasa de conversión, LTV y revenue atribuido a campañas.
Configurar, mantener y auditar el tracking de conversiones mediante Google Tag Manager, pixels de Meta, eventos de GA4 y herramientas de CRM.
Ejecutar pruebas A/B estructuradas de creatividades, audiencias, segmentaciones y landing pages para mejorar sistemáticamente el rendimiento de las campañas.
Explorar y activar nuevos canales de captación: programmatic advertising, native ads, TikTok Ads, LinkedIn Ads u otros que representen oportunidades para el negocio.
Elaborar reportes periódicos de performance con análisis de resultados, insights accionables y recomendaciones de optimización para la dirección de Marketing.
Colaborar con los equipos de Contenido y Diseño para briefear y validar los activos creativos necesarios para las campañas (banners, videos, landing pages, copies).


👀 Nos encantará conocerte si…

Si Disfrutas Tomando Decisiones Basadas En Datos, Optimizando Campañas Con Impacto Real En El Negocio y Trabajando En Entornos Donde Marketing y Revenue Están Estrechamente Conectados, Probablemente Encajarás Muy Bien En Este Rol Si Tienes

✔ Entre 3 y 5 años de experiencia en Performance Marketing, Paid Media o Growth Marketing.

✔ Experiencia gestionando campañas de adquisición en Google Ads y Meta Ads de forma autónoma.

✔ Experiencia trabajando con objetivos de negocio vinculados a generación de leads, adquisición de clientes y revenue.

✔ Capacidad para gestionar presupuestos publicitarios y optimizar inversiones en función del ROI.

✔ Dominio avanzado de Google Ads Manager y Meta Ads Manager.

✔ Experiencia avanzada con Google Analytics 4 (GA4) y Google Tag Manager (GTM).

✔ Conocimiento de herramientas de reporting y visualización de datos como Looker Studio, Power BI o similares.

✔ Experiencia utilizando CRM como Salesforce, HubSpot o equivalentes para el seguimiento del ciclo de vida del lead.

✔ Buen manejo de Excel o Google Sheets para análisis de datos y modelización de métricas.

✔ Mentalidad analítica, orientación a resultados y capacidad para convertir datos en acciones concretas.

✔ Español nativo o nivel avanzado e inglés intermedio (B1+) para trabajar con documentación técnica y colaborar con equipos internacionales.

➕ Será un plus contar con certificaciones de Google Ads o Meta Blueprint, experiencia en entornos HealthTech, SaaS o plataformas digitales, y conocimientos de herramientas de CRO o testing como Unbounce o VWO.

🎯 Cómo nos imaginamos a la persona que tendrá éxito en este rol

Más Allá De La Experiencia Técnica, Creemos Que Las Personas Que Mejor Encajan En Este Tipo De Posición Suelen Compartir Algunas Formas De Trabajar

✔ Toman decisiones basadas en datos y entienden cómo sus acciones impactan en métricas de negocio como el ROI, la rentabilidad y el crecimiento.

✔ Gestionan presupuestos de inversión con criterio, buscando siempre maximizar el impacto de cada euro invertido.

✔ Disfrutan analizando resultados, identificando oportunidades de mejora y optimizando continuamente campañas, procesos y estrategias.

✔ Entienden que el éxito del marketing no termina con la generación de leads, sino que colaboran activamente con los equipos comerciales para mejorar la conversión y la calidad de las oportunidades generadas.

✔ Prestan atención al detalle en aspectos técnicos como el tracking, la medición y la calidad de los datos, asegurando que las decisiones se basen en información fiable.

✔ Se sienten cómodas trabajando en entornos dinámicos, adaptándose con rapidez a los cambios de mercado, nuevas plataformas, algoritmos y comportamientos de los usuarios.

💙 Qué encontrarás al unirte a Top Doctors Group


📈 Posibilidades reales de crecimiento y desarrollo profesional.
💻 Modalidad de trabajo presencial.
🕑 Jornada completa de lunes a viernes de 9:00h a 18:00h
🌎 Un entorno internacional, dinámico y colaborativo
👥 Líderes que priorizan el acompañamiento, la autonomía y el desarrollo de las personas
🥳 Un equipo con el que aprender, crecer y disfrutar del camino


🌱 Diversidad e inclusión

En Top Doctors Group creemos que la diversidad de experiencias, perspectivas y trayectorias nos ayuda a construir mejores equipos y mejores soluciones. Trabajamos para construir un entorno diverso, inclusivo y donde todas las personas tengan las mismas oportunidades para desarrollarse profesionalmente. Si necesitas cualquier adaptación o apoyo durante el proceso de selección, estaremos encantados de ayudarte.

🚀 ¿Te interesa?

Si has llegado hasta aquí y te identificas en buena parte con lo que buscamos, nos encantará conocerte. No creemos en las candidaturas perfectas ni en los perfiles que encajan al 100% sobre el papel, más allá de la experiencia concreta, valoramos aquellas competencias, habilidades y formas de trabajar que permiten aportar valor al equipo y contribuir al crecimiento de la compañía. Si crees que este reto puede encajar contigo, ¡aplica ahora!

Fundada en 2013, Top Doctors Group es un grupo de empresas tecnológicas líder en la digitalización del sector sanitario. A lo largo de nuestra trayectoria, hemos incorporado empresas especializadas y ampliado nuestro modelo hacia soluciones B2B, consolidándonos como un referente internacional en salud digital.

Nuestro propósito es claro: ayudar a cada persona a encontrar al mejor especialista cuando más lo necesita. Hoy, más de 1 millón de personas consultan nuestras plataformas cada mes y más de 10 millones de pacientes han confiado en nosotros en Europa, LATAM, Estados Unidos y Oriente Medio.

A través de nuestras marcas —Top Doctors, Top Health Tech, Ofimedic, iWantGreatCare, Manitex y Top Farma— impulsamos una atención médica más innovadora, eficiente y humana. Somos una compañía global en crecimiento continuo, con un propósito firme: transformar el futuro de la salud a través de la tecnología, el talento y la innovación.

About the job

About us: LocalEyes is a B2B corporate video production company serving mid-market and enterprise clients across 40+ US markets. We're building a durable, multi-channel outbound engine - and we own our systems.




The role: You own our outbound machines end to end: cold email infrastructure, list building, reactivation sends, and signal-based (ABM) campaign execution. You're inheriting a live, producing system from an outgoing operator - warm inboxes, proven offer, documented sequences - with a paid overlap period to learn it. Your job is to run it, improve it, and document it so well that the system never depends on any one person again. Including you.




You will:

Run cold email campaigns end to end: list sourcing → enrichment → verification → sequencing → reply triage → meeting booking handoff
Build and document a multi-source list waterfall (Apollo, Prospeo, Clay enrichment + sources you bring) sized to our ICP: US companies, 50+ employees, $5M+ revenue, approved verticals
Own deliverability: inbox warm-up, domain health, bounce <2%, complaint <0.1%, monthly placement testing
Operate the reactivation engine (300-470 dormant accounts) and, from September, execute signal-based campaigns from our ABM tooling (UserGems)
Report weekly, per vertical: prospects contacted, positive replies per 1K prospects, meetings booked/held/qualified, cost per held qualified meeting - one metric dictionary, no exceptions
Maintain HubSpot hygiene on all outbound-sourced records; run every list against client + active-pipeline suppression before launch
Document everything as SOPs in our systems. Standard: a competent operator could take over in two weeks.




Non-negotiables:

All tools, data, lists, and accounts live in LocalEyes-owned systems. No proprietary processes we can't see.
2+ years hands-on running cold email at 20K+ emails/week (EmailBison, Smartlead, Instantly, or equivalent)
Clay proficiency (build tables, waterfalls, and enrichment flows yourself)
Written English strong enough to edit sequence copy against reply data
You can show campaign metrics you personally produced (reply rates, booked rates, list sizes) and explain the decisions behind them




Targets (honest ones):

Day 30: full system documented and verified under your operation; overlap with outgoing operator complete
Day 60: campaigns running solo at 15K+ prospects/week within deliverability standards
Day 90: 15-20 held qualified meetings/month at <$300 blended cost, with reactivation sends live
Ongoing: sustain the band, expand it by improving positive replies per 1K prospects - our current baseline and ceiling math are shared openly in week one




Reporting: Initially to the CEO; transitions to ops leadership as the growth function matures.

description:
About the job

About The Role

We are seeking an experienced, technically sharp marketing lead for Shopify's 3P Shop Campaigns program. You will own performance, experimentation, and scaling of our Google product advertising portfolio (Performance Max, Shopping, Search Ads), with the opportunity to expand into additional emerging channels over time.

This is not a typical paid media role. You will operate at the intersection of marketing, product feeds, and engineering. A significant part of your work involves managing campaigns with aggressive ROAS targets and expanding the product catalog that powers our ads: millions of merchant products flowing through feed pipelines, eligibility filters, and Google review processes. You will partner closely with engineering and data science teams on catalog health, conversion signal infrastructure, and measurement rigor.

The right person combines hands-on feed/shopping campaign experience with the strategic ability to manage a channel portfolio against efficiency targets, design high-velocity experiments, and communicate performance and trade-offs clearly to leadership.

Why Join Us

You’ll be part of a collaborative Growth team that values creativity, experimentation, and impact. With access to significant budgets, a strong data-driven culture, and exposure to cross-functional experts, you’ll have the opportunity to accelerate your performance media craft, while directly contributing to scaling our business.

Key Responsibilities

Portfolio & Campaign Management


Own day-to-day operations of our Google product advertising program (Performance Max, Shopping, Search Ads & more), managing campaigns against revenue ratio and efficiency targets globally.
Design and execute high-velocity testing pipelines across bidding strategies, campaign structures, audiences, creative, and landing pages.
Over time, extend ownership to additional emerging channels as the portfolio evolves, managing a tiered channel strategy with structured experiments and clear kill criteria.



Catalog & Feed Management


Own the health and growth of the product catalog that powers all advertising: eligibility rules, feed quality, Google Merchant Center policies, and disapproval resolution.
Monitor catalog coverage and identify scaling levers, including eligibility filter tuning, MCA suspension reduction, and feed enrichment opportunities.
Partner with product and engineering teams on catalog pipeline improvements and product vetting automation.



Conversion Signals & Measurement


Partner with engineering to maintain and improve conversion signal pipelines, ensuring signal quality, match rates, and attribution accuracy.
Work with data science on incrementality measurement, attribution model calibration, and valuation frameworks that inform spend allocation decisions.
Monitor signal health (click ID coverage, event volumes, platform-reported vs. internal attribution gaps) and escalate anomalies.



Cross-Functional & Communication


Work with creative strategy to develop effective product advertising programs across the funnel.
Actively communicate program performance, financial health, and strategic trade-offs to marketing leadership and finance stakeholders.



Qualifications


A successful track record managing SEM and product-feed-based advertising campaigns at scale (Shopping, Performance Max, or equivalent), with demonstrated ability to hit efficiency targets.
Direct experience with product feed management and merchant center operations: feed diagnostics, disapproval resolution, eligibility optimization, and catalog scaling.
Experience with SQL. You may not be able to write complex queries from scratch, but you have a high-level understanding of databases and how to query them.
Working knowledge of conversion tracking infrastructure: server-to-server signals, click ID mechanics, attribution windows, and how signal quality affects platform bidding.
Experience partnering with engineering and data science teams on technical marketing problems (feed pipelines, attribution, measurement frameworks).
Ability to design structured experiments with clear hypotheses, kill criteria, and measurement plans.
Strong stakeholder communication skills: you can translate technical performance data into clear narratives for marketing leadership and finance.
Ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment and can navigate through ambiguity and work with minimal guidance.



About Shopify

Opportunity is not evenly distributed. Shopify puts independence within reach for anyone with a dream to start a business. We propel entrepreneurs and enterprises to scale the heights of their potential. Since 2006, we’ve grown to over 8,300 employees and generated over $1 trillion in sales for millions of merchants in 175 countries.

This is life-defining work that directly impacts people’s lives as much as it transforms your own. This is putting the power of the few in the hands of the many, is a future with more voices rather than fewer, and is creating more choices instead of an elite option.

About You

Moving at our pace brings a lot of change, complexity, and ambiguity—and a little bit of chaos. Shopifolk thrive on that and are comfortable being uncomfortable. That means Shopify is not the right place for everyone.

Before you apply, consider if you can:


Care deeply about what you do and about making commerce better for everyone
Excel by seeking professional and personal hypergrowth
Keep up with an unrelenting pace (the week, not the quarter)
Be resilient and resourceful in face of ambiguity and thrive on (rather than endure) change
Bring critical thought and opinion
Put AI agents and tools to work on the tasks they're built for, and focus on the work only humans can do
Embrace differences and disagreement to get shit done and move forward
Work digital-first for your daily work



We may use AI-enabled tools to screen, select, and assess applications. All AI outputs are reviewed and validated by our recruitment team.

title: Business Analyst
description:
About the job

Somos una consultora de ciencia de datos e inteligencia artificial. Ayudamos a empresas a aumentar ventas, reducir costos y mejorar métricas de negocio con soluciones de IA: sistemas de recomendación, modelos predictivos y soluciones agénticas con LLMs. Nos diferenciamos porque hacemos que las cosas pasen: entendemos el negocio, piloteamos, implementamos y monitoreamos. No nos quedamos en la PPT.




Buscamos a una persona con visión de negocio y suficiente literacy técnica de IA para guiar las mejores soluciones.

¿Disfrutas escuchar a un director de tecnología, mapear cómo funciona realmente su negocio, identificar dónde la inteligencia artificial puede mover métricas, y luego conversar con un equipo técnico para co-diseñar la solución?

Este rol fue diseñado para ti.




Eres la persona que entiende el negocio del cliente a profundidad, mapea sus procesos, identifica dónde la IA agrega valor real, y guía a nuestro equipo técnico sobre qué construir y por qué. Eres el par de conversación de un director general y, al mismo tiempo, alguien que sabe lo suficiente de agentes, RAG y LLMs para retar y orientar al equipo de ciencia de datos.




Qué harás

En lo estratégico y de negocio (≈60% del rol)

§ Conducir conversaciones con directores y líderes funcionales del cliente como su par: identificando dolores reales, oportunidades y casos de uso de alto impacto.

§ Mapear procesos de negocio As Is y diseñar el To Be con maestría — usando Lucidchart, BPMN, Miro o equivalentes — de forma que cualquier persona pueda entender el cambio que se está proponiendo.

§ Construir el business case: cuantificar el impacto esperado, definir KPIs de valor (ventas, costo, tiempo, NPS) y de adopción (uso real de la solución), y dar visibilidad ejecutiva del avance.

§ Traducir necesidades de negocio en requerimientos accionables, claros y medibles para el equipo técnico.

§ Acompañar la adopción: asegurar que las soluciones no solo se entreguen, sino que el cliente las use y midan su impacto.




En lo técnico (≈40% del rol)

§ Guiar al equipo de ciencia de datos en la elección de la solución correcta: ¿esto es un problema para un agente, varios agentes, RAG, un modelo predictivo, o realmente no necesita IA?

§ Retar arquitecturas propuestas con preguntas inteligentes: precisión esperada, latencia, costo, riesgos, evaluación.

§ Validar que las entregas técnicas cumplan con los KPIs definidos y con criterios de calidad acordados.

§ Mantener tu conocimiento al día en herramientas y frameworks de IA, especialmente en el espacio agéntico, para tomar mejores decisiones de diseño.




Lo que buscamos en ti

Based in Miami, the team specializes in luxury residential and select commercial real estate throughout Coral Gables, Coconut Grove, Ponce Davis, High Pines, Brickell, and Pinecrest, Brickell and surrounding markets.

The team completes about 50 transactions annually and emphasizes quality, personal service, long-term relationships and thoughtful marketing rather than a high-volume sales approach.




About the Role

The owner is seeking a dedicated Marketing Specialist to help bring structure, consistency, and strategic direction to the team’s marketing efforts.




The team already works with professionals supporting social media, graphic design, photography and video production. The role will connect those efforts into a cohesive marketing plan and ensure that campaigns are executed effectively and consistently across social media, email, print, digital advertising, video and other channels.




This role is less about creating content from scratch and more about coordinating, directing, and elevating what's already in motion — plugging into an existing team and bringing structure, judgment, and a clear point of view on how to market across very different contexts (e.g., a $25M luxury listing vs. a lead-generation campaign vs. brand-building content).




Key Responsibilities

Help develop and execute team’s overall branding and marketing strategy.
Exercise judgment on the right marketing approach depending on context — luxury property listings, lead generation, commercial properties, or brand/trust-building content.
Maintain a coordinated marketing calendar across social media, email, print, video, advertising, and listing launches.
Coordinate print marketing (mailers, direct mail)
Plan and execute email marketing campaigns. Graphic design skillset is a plus.
Coordinate and guide video content — this role won't be hands-on editing but will direct editors (both social media and property/production video teams) on brand-consistent creative direction, to reduce back-and-forth revision cycles
Help reduce unnecessary revision cycles by providing clear, brand-consistent direction at the beginning of each project.
Write and refine property descriptions, emails, advertisements, brochures, social media copy, video scripts, presentations, and other marketing materials.
Oversee brand management and consistency across all channels.
Identify and execute lead-generation and client-nuturing opportunities.
Bring proactive, creative recommendations rather than just executing requested tasks
Track campaign results and recommend improvements based on performance.
Coordinate projects and follow up with team members, vendors, designers, photographers, and video professionals.
Maintain a high level of professionalism, discretion, accuracy, and responsiveness.
Demonstrate an understanding of the high-service, luxury client experience — from first touchpoint through the full sales process




Must-Have Qualifications

College degree in marketing, communications, advertising, business, or a related field
Minimum 5 years of marketing experience
Fully bilingual: English + Spanish (Portuguese is a strong added value, not required)
Excellent English-language copywriting/storytelling ability
Ability to manage multiple campaigns and deadlines simultaneously.
Good judgment and the ability to adapt marketing strategy to different audiences and objectives.
Strong attention to detail and commitment to producing polished work.




Nice-to-Have Qualifications

Real estate marketing experience
Experience in luxury/high-end market branding
Experience with Mailchimp or a similar email-marketing platform.
Experience managing Meta advertising or other paid digital campaigns.
Familiarity with Canva, Adobe Photoshop, Adobe Illustrator, or similar creative tools.
Experience using a CRM, content calendar, or project-management platform.
Comfort using AI tools to support research, workflow, copy development, and content optimization.
Portuguese-language proficiency.




What Success Looks Like

Within the first several months, the successful candidate will:

Create a clear and organized marketing calendar.
Improve coordination among social media, email, print, video, and listing-marketing efforts.
Reduce missed deadlines and unnecessary revision cycles.
Improve consistency across the Scott Shuffield Group brand.
Bring forward thoughtful campaign ideas and lead-generation opportunities.
Help the team evaluate marketing performance using meaningful metrics.
Reduce the amount of day-to-day marketing coordination required from Scott and the team.




Interview Process

Interview 1 — 30 minutes with Client
Interview 2 — Group interview with the team
Trial Task — Highly recommended given this is a creative role; candidate completes a paid trial assignment before a final decision is made

description:
About the job

About Toptal

Toptal is a global network of top talent in business, design, and technology that enables companies to scale their teams, on-demand. With $200+ million in annual revenue and team members based around the globe, Toptal is the world’s largest fully remote workforce.

We take the best elements of virtual teams and combine them with a support structure that encourages innovation, social interaction, and fun. We see no borders, move at a fast pace, and are never afraid to break the mold.

Job Summary:

As a Creator Agent for a new venture within Toptal, you will work directly with the General Manager and the Operations Director to onboard, coach, and accelerate the growth of our Content Creator users. You will join an execution-driven team building a new business unit from zero. Your mindset must be that of a builder, not just a coach.

This role has two core missions:


 Deliver hands-on creator growth: You will coach creators 1-to-1 to grow their audience, increase their engagement, and monetize their content. You will analyze their entire content plan end-to-end. You will challenge them with personalized weekly tasks that improve key metrics such as click-through-rate, retention rate, followers growth, and engagement rate. Once creators reach strong traction, you will also identify new revenue opportunities and activate brand deals. 
 Build the foundations of the Creator Agent function: As our first full-time Creator Agent, you will design, test, and refine the methodologies that power our coaching model. You will transform your learnings into structured playbooks, training materials, and repeatable processes that will allow us to scale a high-performing agent team. 


This is not a passive coaching position. You will think like a strategist, operate like a creator, and build like an early-stage founder. You must be able to analyze performance data, communicate clearly, and move quickly.

The ideal candidate is a senior creator strategist with real, proven experience growing accounts on YouTube, Instagram, or TikTok. You understand how content scales, why packaging matters, and how to push creators to become consistent, professional, and commercially ready.

This is a remote position. Resumes and communication must be submitted in English.

Responsibilities:

The following information is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or required skills.


Conduct creators onboarding, assess performance, and identify growth opportunities across platforms. 
Provide 1-to-1 coaching focused on improving content strategy, packaging, and execution (from scripting to community building). 
Define weekly goals and metrics that drive measurable growth. 
Guide creators toward professional publishing standards and consistent audience development. 
Support creators in preparing for monetization and activate brand opportunities when appropriate. 
Design, test, and refine the coaching methodologies that will scale the Creator Agent function. 
Convert insights into structured playbooks, templates, and training materials for future agents. 
Partner with the Operations Director to strengthen creator success processes and growth frameworks. 
Collaborate with marketing, product, and partnerships teams on creator-facing initiatives. 
Stay ahead of platform trends, algorithm shifts, and best practices to update our approach continuously. 
Exercise discretion and independent judgment. 


In the first week, expect to:


Study the Creator onboarding guide to understand the core levers that drive growth on YouTube, Instagram, and TikTok. 
Shadow real creator calls to learn how we onboard clients and how agents deliver feedback on content, strategy, and packaging. 
Review internal examples of strong creator diagnostics and session flows to understand our quality bar. 
Start building your own approach for analyzing creators during onboarding sessions. 


In the first month, expect to:


Work cross-functionally with our support team to improve your clients’ visual quality and editing quality. 
Start working with 1-5 clients by identifying their growth opportunities, providing actionable feedback, and giving them clear weekly tasks that drive metric improvement. 
Start drafting your methodology playbook to guide your client meetings, analyze performance, and structure a repeatable coaching rhythm. 


In the first three months, expect to:


Take full ownership of tracking, measuring, and driving progress for your client portfolio. 
Manage around 15 creators with a consistent coaching rhythm that includes goals, metric reviews, tailored feedback, and next steps. 
Build the first complete version of the Creator Agent playbook based on your learnings from real clients. 
Identify patterns across creators and propose scalable solutions, templates, and frameworks. 


In the first six months, expect to:


Guide at least one creator from zero monetization to first revenue. 
Demonstrate consistent metric improvement across your creator portfolio. 
Build the first version of a repeatable coaching model with templates and scorecards. 
Identify the core traits that predict creator success and use them to refine how we assess and coach creators. 
Mentor incoming agents and help set the performance bar for the function. 


In the first year, expect to:


Scale multiple creators to consistent monetization. 
Recognize the traits and behaviors that consistently predict creator growth, and use these insights to improve how we select and coach creators. 
Establish the operating system for the Creator Agent team including training standards and core frameworks. 
Mentor incoming agents and help set the performance bar for the function. 


Qualifications and Job Requirements:


A bachelor’s degree is required. 
Proven experience growing social media accounts on YouTube, Instagram, and/or TikTok. 
Strong understanding of content strategy fundamentals: ideation, hooks, titles, thumbnails, and retention, conversion, and community building. 
Ability to analyze performance data and translate insights into clear, actionable guidance. 
Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English. 
Experience in roles that require coaching, advising, or client accountability. 
Ability to break down creative work into structured frameworks and teachable steps. 
Strong organizational discipline to manage around 10 creators weekly. 
Availability to work in the Americas time zone.

Bonus points if you:

title: User Experience Researcher
description:
About the job

UX Researcher & UX Copywriter




Job Summary




We are seeking a creative and user-focused UX Researcher & UX Copywriter to help design intuitive digital experiences through user research, usability testing, and clear, engaging content. The ideal candidate will combine research, analytics, and UX writing skills to improve product usability and customer satisfaction while collaborating closely with designers, product managers, and development teams.




Key Responsibilities




- Plan and conduct user interviews to gather customer insights and understand user needs.

- Design and execute usability testing sessions to evaluate product effectiveness and identify usability issues.

- Support and analyze A/B testing initiatives to optimize user experience and content.

- Create clear, concise, and user-friendly UX copy for web and mobile applications.

- Develop and review wireframes and prototypes in collaboration with UX/UI designers.

- Analyze user behavior and product performance using analytics tools to inform design decisions.

- Collaborate with product managers, designers, developers, and stakeholders throughout the product development lifecycle.

- Present research findings and recommendations to cross-functional teams.

- Maintain documentation of research findings, usability reports, and content guidelines.




Required Qualifications




- Bachelor's degree in Human-Computer Interaction (HCI), Psychology, Design, Communications, Marketing, or a related field.

- 3+ years of experience in UX research, UX writing, or user experience design.

- Experience conducting user interviews, usability testing, and A/B testing.

- Strong UX writing and content strategy skills.

- Experience creating or reviewing wireframes and prototypes.

- Familiarity with analytics tools and interpreting user behavior data.

- Excellent communication, presentation, and collaboration skills.

- Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.




Technical Skills




- User Interviews

- Usability Testing

- A/B Testing

- UX Writing

- Wireframes

- Prototypes

- Analytics

- User Research

- Collaboration

- Content Strategy




Preferred Qualifications




- Experience with UX design tools such as Figma, Sketch, or Adobe XD.

- Familiarity with Google Analytics, Mixpanel, or similar analytics platforms.

- Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments.

- Knowledge of accessibility (WCAG) and inclusive design principles.

- Portfolio demonstrating UX research and writing projects.

skills: Upon receiving of the customer schedules (via EDI, webEDI or paper), ensure that the Customer requirements are integrated into the system and any integration errors are dealt with and resolved. Loading closed orders onto the system.

Identify & highlight large order variations between the schedules that were forecasted by the Customer & those that are firmed up by the Customer, ensuring that the data has been accurately supplied from the Customer.
If necessary, release picking lists for the Customers’ deliveries.

Follow the complete Supply Chain (procurement, production, and shipping) and chase if necessary, ensure that targeted service levels to the Customer are reached. Monitor the safety stock levels and alert when the min / max levels are reached.
Manage co-operation and logistics issues with logistics external platforms
Ensure that the correct parameters are applied to each reference (MOQ, lead-time, transportation schedule), and if necessary, initiate corrective action plans.
Be aware of/integrated in P1 and P0 projects (new references, new packaging, transfers, new Customers…). Ensure that the returnable packaging loops are adhered to, preventing any packaging shortages.
Prepare the Customs documentation required for exporting if need be.

On a regular basis, communicate complete, precise & reliable information to the Customer contacts. Adapt the chosen method of communication to the level of the Customer contact. Adapt the frequency to the situation (preventative, curative, crisis).
Meet the Customer contacts on a regular basis (once a year for major Customers).
Ensure that the internal scheduling has been launched, taking into account the Customers’ priorities. Make or Ensure the production sequencing based on real customer demand
Measure the daily service rate for each Customer (using the Customers’ calculation and also the internal Customer Service Rate (CSR) calculation). Propose action plans to improve the service level.

Alert sales in the event of a crisis (Customer or internal), to define priorities with the Customer & internally (management, VS for the aftermarket), follow the evolution of any associated action plans. If necessary, escalate through the Logistics Red Alert application.

Make sure that there is a backup for each Customer & train the backup on the way to manage the Customers’ account; ensure that during holidays the position is covered & that both internal & external Customers are notified in advance of the absence and informed of the person that will be temporarily managing the Customers’ account.

Representada en más de 50 países y con productos vendidos en más de 170, el Grupo Ferrero encanta a numerosas generaciones en todo el planeta. ¿Cuál es el secreto de nuestro éxito mundial? 40,000 empleados especializados que celebran tanto el cuidado como la calidad para forjar un negocio, carreras profesionales y marcas de las que nos sentimos orgullosos. About the job

The North Face was built on love for the outdoors and the desire to enable all types of exploration, for all people, from their backyards to the Himalayas. Over the last 50 years we've lived by our “true north,” the belief that exploration has the power to change us, to challenge us and to help us see the world from new perspectives.




To help ignite a global movement of outdoor exploration, love for the natural world and an unwavering commitment to protect it, we welcome and encourage new participants to the outdoors. We extend our reach through support of non-profit organizations, establishing programs that connect participants with close-to-home recreation opportunities, and creating a connection with young leaders, inspiring them to explore and conserve. As we enter our sixth decade, we pledge to:




Empower exploration and the thrill of the unknown for as many people as possible.

Protect the places where we live, play, and operate.

Evolve the way we make our products by improving our environmental performance and social responsibility in the supply chain.




Retail Allocation Analyst, The North Face




The Retail Allocation Analyst is responsible for optimizing inventory investments across the retail store fleet by developing and executing allocation and replenishment strategies that maximize sales, inventory productivity, and consumer satisfaction.

This role partners closely with the Buyer, Planning team, Distribution Center, Store Operations, and Retail Leadership to ensure the right product is available in the right store, at the right time and in the right quantity. The Retail Allocator Analyst leverages sales, inventory, and performance data to make allocation decisions that support financial targets, inventory turn objectives, and seasonal merchandising strategies

Develop and Execute Allocation Strategies: Manage inventory allocation and replenishment across the store fleet to support sales plans, inventory productivity, and profitability targets.

Provide Business Insights and Support Retail Growth: Develop reporting and actionable insights to support decision-making, while planning inventory needs for new store openings, remodels, and key retail initiatives

About The Role

We're looking for a LATAM Marketing Lead to be the region's marketing owner — the person who takes global strategy and brand from our Growth team and turns it into a localized, executed plan across Mexico, Brazil, and West LATAM. This is a hands-on, plug-and-play role: no team, no existing playbook, just a market that needs someone to build the demand engine from the ground up and run it themselves.

You'll own everything from events and partner co-marketing to social, content, PR, and demand gen — executing directly rather than coordinating through an agency or a team. If you've built a brand and pipeline from zero before and want to do it again for a fast-growing AI company, this is the role.

What We're Looking For

Why join us?


Opportunity to work at a high-growth AI startup, backed by top investors.
Rapidly growing and backed by top investors including a16z, Y Combinator, and Base10.
Ownership & Autonomy - Take full ownership of projects and ship fast.
Top-Tier Compensation - Competitive salary + equity in a high-growth startup.
Comprehensive Benefits - Healthcare, dental, vision coverage.
Work With the Best - Join a world-class team of engineers and builders.


Our Operating Principles

Extreme Ownership 

We take full responsibility for our work, outcomes, and team success. No excuses, no blame-shifting — if something needs fixing, we own it and make it better. This means stepping up, even when it’s not “your job.” If a ball is dropped, we pick it up. If a customer is unhappy, we fix it. If a process is broken, we redesign it. We don’t wait for someone else to solve it — we lead with accountability and expect the same from those around us.

Craftsmanship 

Putting care and intention into every task, striving for excellence, and taking deep ownership of the quality and outcome of your work. Craftsmanship means never settling for “just fine.” We sweat the details because details compound. Whether it’s a product feature, an internal doc, or a sales call — we treat it as a reflection of our standards. We aim to deliver jaw-dropping customer experiences by being curious, meticulous, and proud of what we build — even when nobody’s watching.

We are “majos”

Be friendly & have fun with your coworkers. Always be genuine & honest, but kind. “Majo” is our way of saying: be a good human. Be approachable, helpful, and warm. We’re building something ambitious, and it’s easier (and more fun) when we enjoy the ride together. We give feedback with kindness, challenge each other with respect, and celebrate wins together without ego.

Urgency with Focus

Create the highest impact in the shortest amount of time. Move fast, but in the right direction. We operate with speed because time is our most limited resource. But speed without focus is chaos. We prioritize ruthlessly, act decisively, and stay aligned. We aim for high leverage: the biggest results from the simplest, smartest actions. We’re running a high-speed marathon — not a sprint with no strategy.

Talent Density and Meritocracy

Hire only people who can raise the average; ‘exceptional performance is the passing grade.’ Ability trumps seniority. We believe the best teams are built on talent density — every hire should raise the bar. We reward contribution, not titles or tenure. We give ownership to those who earn it, and we all hold each other to a high standard. A-players want to work with other A-players — that’s how we win.

First-Principles Thinking

Strip a problem to physics-level facts, ignore industry dogma, rebuild the solution from scratch. We don’t copy-paste solutions. We go back to basics, ask why things are the way they are, and rebuild from the ground up if needed. This mindset pushes us to innovate, challenge stale assumptions, and move faster than incumbents. It’s how we build what others think is impossible.

description:
About the job

About the Company



Birdman is a fast-growing, plant-based consumer brand on a mission to nourish people with nutritious, sustainable, and delicious foods — free from animal cruelty and with a smaller environmental footprint. We operate with a strong builder mindset, combining creativity, data, and execution to scale brand presence and cultural relevance across markets.

Our Brand Experience & Partnerships team turns relationships into results — partnering with the right people and the right entities to make our brands culturally relevant, credible, and unmistakably ours.

Job Description



We are looking for an Influencer & Partnerships Analyst to build and manage the day-to-day of our partnerships in the assigned market (Mexico or the US) — both with entities (corporate alliances, on-premise opportunities, sponsorships) and with people (influencers, celebrities, and creators).

This is a hands-on, execution-focused role that converts the partnerships strategy of the Head of Brand Experience & Partnerships into a living program: scouting and assessing the right profiles, ensuring every partner aligns with the values and personality of our brands, managing agreements and deliverables, and making every result measurable and quantifiable.

You will work closely with Brand Management, Social & Community, Birdman Studio, and Legal & Finance to ensure quality, consistency, and impact across every partnership.

Key Responsibilities


Run the day-to-day of the influencer and creator program in the assigned market: scouting, assessing, and managing relationships to keep a living roster of the right voices.
Assess every potential partner — person or entity — against the values and personality of each portfolio brand, backed by quantitative impact and profitability analysis.
Identify corporate alliance and on-premise opportunities and build the business case inputs, feeding the Head of Brand Experience & Partnerships a qualified pipeline.
Review partner and influencer content against briefs and brand guidelines, coordinating briefings, revisions, and approvals before publication, and escalating deviations.
Manage the agreements, deliverables, and usage rights of every partnership, supporting negotiations and following through on contracts, timelines, and compliance.
Track and control influencer and partnerships spend in the assigned market, flagging deviations early to execute on budget.
Coordinate the amplification of every partnership with the Social & Community Lead across owned and earned content.
Measure program performance — reach, interactions, earned media, cost per impact — and feed the program's dashboards to enable quantitative decisions.

Are you ready to take the flight?



Requirements



Experience

Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communication, Advertising, or a related field.
+2 years in influencer marketing or partnerships for consumer brands.
+2 years negotiating with talent agencies, creators, or commercial partners.
+2 years using social analytics and measurement tools.
Experience with culturally relevant or sports / lifestyle brands is a strong plus.
Bilingual English (full oral and written command); native Spanish.
Eligible to work in Guadalajara, Jalisco (we provide relocation support if needed).
Able to work on-site in Guadalajara and travel up to 30% as needed.

Technical Skills

Influencer marketing: creator ecosystem, platform dynamics (Meta and TikTok primarily), briefing methodology, usage rights, and disclosure standards.
Partnerships & alliances: sponsorships, on-premise dynamics, commercial alliance structures, and business case building.
Measurement: reach and engagement metrics, earned media value, cost per impact, dashboards, and reporting.
Brand & legal basics: brand guidelines, values and personality fit, and contract and compliance fundamentals.


Benefits

description:
About the job

About Inhabit

Inhabit is a global PropTech software company serving over 5 million units in the residential and short-term rental property management industries. Our 1,500+ team members drive strategic partnerships, deliver best-in-class software solutions and services, and foster innovation and collaboration across software, payments, and insurance. Learn more at, visit inhabit.com.

About Streamline

Streamline is a leading software platform built for professional vacation rental and property management companies. Our technology powers the full operational lifecycle of property managers — from reservations, distribution, and accounting to maintenance operations, guest communications, and owner experience.

We partner with professional property managers to help them streamline operations, scale efficiently, maximize revenue, and deliver exceptional guest experiences through automation, data, and modern technology.

As we continue expanding globally, including strategic growth initiatives across Mexico and emerging international markets, we are investing in high-performing sales professionals who are passionate about technology, hospitality, and helping property managers grow their businesses.

Job Description

The Account Executive is responsible for generating, managing, and closing new business opportunities within the vacation rental and property management industry. This role focuses on proactive outbound prospecting, consultative sales engagement, relationship development, and guiding prospective clients through the full sales cycle.

As part of Streamline’s international growth strategy, this position plays a key role in expanding our presence across Mexico and emerging markets throughout the region. We are seeking a highly motivated, self-driven sales professional who thrives in fast-paced environments, and is comfortable navigating evolving markets.

The ideal candidate combines strong business development skills with a consultative approach, enabling them to engage with property management companies ranging from growing operators to large, multi-market organizations. Success in this role requires the ability to build trust quickly, identify operational challenges, communicate business value effectively, and develop long-term client relationships.

What You’ll Do (Functions & Responsibilities)



Generate new business through outbound prospecting, networking, and partner channels
Manage the full sales cycle: discovery, solution positioning, demos, proposal, and close
Conduct consultative sales conversations with property management leaders and stakeholders
Deliver product demonstrations aligned to prospect needs and operational challenges
Develop a strong understanding of Streamline’s platform, industry trends, and the operational challenges facing professional property managers
Build and manage a strong pipeline within assigned territory (Mexico / LATAM markets)
Re-engage prior prospects and inactive customers to reopen opportunities
Collaborate with marketing, partnerships, and account management to drive pipeline growth
Maintain accurate pipeline management, forecasting, and activity tracking within CRM systems 
Represent Streamline at industry events, conferences, and market visits as needed



Qualifications

What We’re Looking For (Minimum qualifications)



4+ years of sales experience in SaaS, property management, proptech, or related industries 
Proven track record of meeting or exceeding quota in a closing role 
Experience managing full-cycle sales processes in a consultative environment 
Strong communication and presentation skills, including virtual demos 
Ability to navigate multiple stakeholders and influence decision-makers 
Entrepreneurial mindset with the ability to operate in a growth/expansion market 
Experience working in or selling into Mexico or Latin America 
Bilingual (Spanish/English) 
Strong business acumen and data-driven mindset



Education Requirements



Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience preferred



Type



Full time



Location/Travel



Remote Mexico
